ForgePact#114 Live 1, 2026-09-30, research build of the #114 branch, character Suh (Samurai, level 100) in Town_02_rm. Blade Barrier (talent 137, abilityCooldown 8 s, level 1) was cast from code (`tgprobe cast 137`) and its cooldown measured as the number of StatSpellHaste reads the ForgePact hook counted while it ran (`statadd list` calls=), one read per step. The hook was installed as a pass-through first, so the bonus-0 runs count too. A1 (2026-10-01, the same character and build) cast For Honor (talent 142) instead and read the buff it adds, `buffValue` of buff type 42, through `skillprobe state bind=id:<buff instance>.buffValue`.

source.section: Skill Haste and All Skills in `statadd`

measurements.what: Bonus 0: Blade Barrier's cooldown ran for 392 reads, and 397 in a second run. The character's own Skill Haste was 40 (the first-call line of the next run: `first boosted call 40 -> 140`). Reads came 30 per 0.5 s poll, one per step at 60 steps/s, and none while no cooldown ran.
measurements.model: cooldown_steps(base, 40) with base about 473 steps (8 s at 60 steps/s, less what the cast itself takes): base / 1.2.

source.section: Skill Haste and All Skills in `statadd`

measurements.what: `statadd skillhaste` +100, +120, +160, +200 and +300 over the native 40: the hook returned 140, 160, 200, 240 and 340 (first-call lines 40 -> 140 and 40 -> 340 logged), and the cooldown ran for 280, 265, 238, 238 and 238 reads.
measurements.model: base / (1 + min(total, 200) / 200): totals up to 200 shorten the cooldown as the static reading's 0.005 per point says; 240 and 340 take exactly as long as 200, so the game counts at most 200.

source.section: Skill Haste and All Skills in `statadd`

measurements.what: For Honor (talent 142, one point allocated) cast from code with `statadd allskills` at 0 and at +19. The hook's first-call line read the character's own All Skills total, 28, and returned 47. The buff For Honor adds (buff type 42, `buffValue`) was [137.8, 72.5, 0] at 0 and [228, 120, 0] at +19: 4.75 and 2.5 per level, at level 29 (1 point + 28) and 48 (+19). `ReportClient` was never called (0 calls, skillprobe's controls climbing). The save afterwards differed from the one before only in playtime and the class's time.
measurements.model: talent_level(1, 28) = 29 and talent_level(1, 28 + 19) = 48; For Honor's buff is level x [4.75, 2.5].
